summary.text: Josh West has represented Oklahoma's 5th House District since January 2017 and serves as Majority Floor Leader. He is a U.S. Army veteran who was deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan.

paragraphs.text: West was raised in Grove, graduated from Grove High School in 1995 and attended Missouri Valley College on a football scholarship.
In October 2003 he was shot multiple times in a firefight in Karbala, Iraq, while evacuating his injured battalion commander, and he received the Purple Heart and the Bronze Star with Valor device.
He was medically retired from the Army in 2005 after nine years of service and was elected to the House in 2016.
He previously served as Majority Leader and is a co-founder and former chair of the Legislative Veterans Caucus.
